service.error.invalid_argument.context: Core service request rejection; field is an invariant field identifier, inserted literally and never translated.

service.error.resource_limit.context: Core service resource cap rejection; resource is an invariant resource identifier, inserted literally and never translated.

service.error.not_found.context: Core service requested resource is absent; do not expose resource identifiers or infer authorization.

service.error.revision_conflict.context: Core service revision or uniqueness conflict; no automatic retry or overwrite is implied.

service.error.internal.context: Core service internal failure; raw causes and sensitive details are intentionally omitted.

service.error.storage_io.context: Core service storage I/O failure; do not expose paths or promise recovery or automatic retries.

service.error.metadata_unavailable.context: Core service metadata database failure; do not expose queries or promise recovery or automatic retries.
